taste:
Whitby Breaded Scampi combines a crisp breadcrumb coating with tender, slightly sweet seafood. The whole-tail pieces give you a clear contrast between the crunchy exterior and the softer centre. Its delicate flavour makes the tartare sauce useful rather than incidental: the sharpness cuts across the sweetness, while dipping lets you control how much sauce accompanies each mouthful.

Chips and garden peas make this a familiar seaside-style meal rather than scampi served on its own. The hearty portion of chips gives the plate substance, with the pot of tartare alongside for dipping. A squeeze of fresh lemon complements the seafood if you prefer that sharper finish. Choose it for breadcrumb crunch rather than the battered coating of cod and chips.
